paragraphs.text:
You  and  your  students  contemplate  your  trek  back  to  Fort 
McDonald. There are many possible routes.

If any of your party require healing, you may restore 1 hit point each. 
To follow the river, go to 60. To gain elevation where you can, go to 
552. To use the mountains as a landmark, go to 56. To hug the tree 
line, go to 233. To explore the deep woods, go to 461.
